parameters.content:
StartCollaborativeBuild
  ├─ Generate sessionId
  ├─ Save to DB
  └─ Execute: SpawnWorkers (pass taskDivision too)
      ↓
SpawnWorkers
  ├─ Spawn workers (workerCount: 3)
  ├─ Append to spawnedWorkers array
  └─ Execute: WaitAndRegister (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
WaitAndRegister
  ├─ Wait for workers ready
  ├─ Register workers
  └─ Execute: CoordinateBuild (pass taskDivision)
      ↓
CoordinateBuild
  ├─ Create session
  ├─ Get position
  ├─ Reserve location
  ├─ Teleport workers
  └─ Execute: DistributeTasks (pass taskDivision) ← HERE!
      ↓
DistributeTasks
  ├─ Function: Convert taskDivision to array
  ├─ Loop through tasks
  ├─ HTTP POST send-task to each worker
  └─ Complete

plan.buildingRequest: Building a small hut close to player Mauri67's current position using one worker.

Worker1.objective: Build complete small hut structure from foundation to finished interior
Worker1.assumptions: You are already positioned at the build site. All necessary materials are in inventory.
constraints: Do NOT break existing terrain outside build boundaries (x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29)
Do NOT place blocks above y:-53 (roof peak height)
Do NOT leave incomplete structures between stages

Worker1.subtask: Build foundation outline for small hut
Worker1.objective: Establish stable foundation base for hut structure
constraints: Do NOT place blocks outside x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29 range
Do NOT break more than 6 sequential blocks
Place foundation only at y:-60 (single layer)
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, beginning Stage 1 of 4: Foundation.

You are already positioned at your build site. Begin building immediately.

TASK: Build the foundation outline for a small hut using cobblestone.

COORDINATES: x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29, y:-60

PATTERN: Create a 6x6 block square foundation outline:
- Corners at: (-27,23), (-27,29), (-21,23), (-21,29)
- Place cobblestone blocks in a complete perimeter at y:-60
- Inner dimensions will be 4x4 (interior space)

MATERIAL ASSUMPTION: You have at least 20 cobblestone blocks in inventory.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks outside x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29
- Do NOT break more than 6 sequential blocks
- Place foundation only at y:-60 (single layer)

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. No waiting, no dependencies. Build the complete foundation outline now.

Worker1.subtask: Build interior floor and exterior walls
Worker1.objective: Create enclosed walls and walkable floor for hut interior
constraints: Do NOT place blocks outside x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29 perimeter
Do NOT exceed y:-56 on walls (4 blocks high: y:-59 to y:-56)
Do NOT place blocks at foundation level (y:-60)
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, Stage 2 of 4: Walls and Floor.

You are already positioned at your build site. Begin building immediately.

TASK: Build interior floor and exterior walls using oak_planks.

FLOOR (y:-59):
- Fill entire interior: x:-26 to -22, z:24 to 28 with oak_planks
- Create continuous 4x4 interior floor (16 blocks)

WALLS (y:-58 to y:-56, 3 blocks high):
- Build walls on all four sides of the hut
- North wall: x:-27 to -21, z:23, y:-58 to -56
- South wall: x:-27 to -21, z:29, y:-58 to -56
- East wall: x:-21, z:23 to 29, y:-58 to -56
- West wall: x:-27, z:23 to 29, y:-58 to -56
- Total wall blocks needed: 24 blocks

MATERIAL ASSUMPTION: You have at least 40 oak_planks (16 floor + 24 walls).

COORDINATES:
- Interior floor: x:-26 to -22, z:24 to 28, y:-59
- Exterior walls: perimeter at x:-27,-21, z:23,29, height y:-58 to -56

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks outside x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29 perimeter
- Do NOT exceed y:-56 on walls (4 blocks high maximum)
- Do NOT place blocks at foundation level (y:-60)

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Build floor first (bottom to top is faster), then walls. Complete both now.

Worker1.objective: Create peaked roof with sloped sides meeting at center ridge
constraints: Do NOT place blocks outside x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29
Do NOT exceed y:-53 (roof peak height)
Do NOT place blocks below y:-55
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, Stage 3 of 4: Roof.

You are already positioned at your build site. Begin building immediately.

TASK: Build gabled roof using oak_stairs and oak_slab ridge cap.

ROOF RIDGE (center line): x:-24, z:23 to 29, y:-53 (peak height)

WEST SLOPE (x:-27 to -25):
- y:-55: Place oak_stairs at x:-27 and x:-26, facing EAST (ascending toward ridge)
- y:-54: Place oak_stairs at x:-25, facing EAST
- Pattern: stairs slope upward from west wall toward ridge
- Total: 6 stair blocks (2 per row, 3 rows depth z:23-29)

EAST SLOPE (x:-23 to -21):
- y:-55: Place oak_stairs at x:-21 and x:-22, facing WEST (ascending toward ridge)
- y:-54: Place oak_stairs at x:-23, facing WEST
- Pattern: stairs slope upward from east wall toward ridge
- Total: 6 stair blocks

RIDGE CAP (center, y:-53):
- Place oak_slab at x:-24, z:23 to 29, y:-53, facing NORTH (ridge top cap)
- Total: 7 slab blocks along ridge

MATERIAL ASSUMPTION: You have 12 oak_stairs and 7 oak_slab in inventory.

COORDINATES:
- West slope: x:-27 to -25, z:23 to 29, y:-55 to -54
- East slope: x:-23 to -21, z:23 to 29, y:-55 to -54
- Ridge cap: x:-24, z:23 to 29, y:-53

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT place blocks outside x:-27 to -21, z:23 to 29
- Do NOT exceed y:-53 (roof peak height)
- Do NOT place blocks below y:-55

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Build west slope first, then east slope, then ridge cap. Complete entire roof now.

Worker1.subtask: Add door entrance and interior furnishings
Worker1.objective: Finalize hut with functional door and basic interior
constraints: Do NOT modify walls or roof from previous stages
Do NOT place blocks above y:-57
Place door in south-facing wall only
Worker1.fullPrompt:
You are Worker1, Stage 4 of 4: Door and Interior Details (Final Stage).

You are already positioned at your build site. Begin building immediately.

TASK: Add door entrance and place basic interior furnishings.

DOOR (south wall, centered):
- Location: x:-24, z:29 (center of south wall)
- Bottom block: y:-59
- Top block: y:-58
- Type: oak_door
- Placement: Opens inward (into hut)

INTERIOR FURNISHINGS:
- Bed: Place at x:-26, z:25, y:-59, head pointing NORTH
- Crafting Table: Place at x:-22, z:25, y:-59
- Torch (wall-mounted for lighting): x:-25, y:-57 (on west wall, attached to top surface)

MATERIAL ASSUMPTION: You have 1 oak_door, 1 bed, 1 crafting_table, and 1 torch.

COORDINATES:
- Door: x:-24, z:29, y:-59 to -58 (2 blocks tall)
- Bed: x:-26, z:25, y:-59
- Crafting Table: x:-22, z:25, y:-59
- Torch: x:-25, z:23, y:-57 (interior wall)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT modify walls or roof from previous stages
- Do NOT place blocks above y:-57
- Place door in south-facing wall only (do not modify other walls)

BEGIN IMMEDIATELY. Place door first (functional entrance), then interior items. Complete hut interior now.

HUTCOMPLETE: When all blocks are placed, your small hut is fully finished and ready for occupation.
